reason: I'd probably play with the free tricks, but 99 ₪ by card on some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store, without having seen a video of it actually fooling someone, is not my kind of impulse buy. I buy after a clip blows my mind, and this is just a description.
objection: I'm not a magician, I'll fumble the secret part and my friends will catch me on the spot, and then I've paid 99 ₪ to embarrass myself.
would_change_my_mind: A short Reel of a regular non-magician person doing the gallery or incoming-call trick at a party and the friends freaking out, plus the free trick actually working smoothly for me the first time.
